scope: Fortress flat-ground low-speed directional/stability checks; not a velocity-accuracy or physical-hardware acceptance
friction_semantics: Assumed joint-side passive sliding loads, independent calves only; no real hardware compensation, stiction, backlash or measured efficiency model

forward.calibration_scope: Simulation joints already use URDF coordinates; real encoder/mechanical calibration is not certified.

final_diagnostics.joint_array_encoding: JSON numeric arrays; null means unavailable or non-finite
final_diagnostics.joint_effort_feedback_semantics: simulated motor-PD requested joint effort; not measured hardware torque or foot force
final_diagnostics.stand_up_final_target_error_semantics: maximum over valid finite joint positions only; final target, not interpolated target
final_diagnostics.controller_request_semantics: controller command-interface request; not final motor packet or measured torque; hardware may scale/disable it
final_diagnostics.joy_request_snapshot: latest buffered Joy at diagnostic sampling; may postdate the control update snapshot; not an accepted mode

sampled_budget_reconstruction.semantics: Inferred from controller requests and feedback at approximately 10 Hz diagnostic samples; not a 500 Hz hardware-boundary trace; cannot exclude missed transients or quantization effects

fingerprint_scope: Primary control/configuration inputs and local control-package libraries; not all middleware, simulator, or third-party dependencies
limitations: No real serial device or motor motion; no onboard deadline certification
20 ms and friction are stress assumptions, not identified hardware parameters
Combined delay/friction profile retains substantial forward speed bias; directional test pass does not mean accurate tracking
IMU remains 100 Hz and attitude prediction remains disabled; no PD or NMPC/WBC weight retuning
Raw logs remain ignored and are not committed

physics_100hz_summary.source: 100 Hz independent physics odometry in kinematics.csv; controller mode from diagnostics
